name: Andy the Abyss Angler
description: A weathered fisherman who plumbs the deepest dungeon pits with his loyal hound. Patient, resourceful, and never without his trusty rod.
lore: A weathered fisherman who abandoned the surface long ago, drawn by whispers from the deep. He descends with his loyal hound Bernie at his side, casting lines into waters no sane angler would touch.
mechanics: Bernie fights alongside your fish party, using his Loyal Bite attack each turn. The Harmony grid lets equipped items grant double-strike bonuses when placed in aligned rows.
